name: Baba Arts Limited
about: Baba Arts Limited engages in the production and distribution of cinematic and television content in the United Kingdom and India. The company operates through three segments: Trading IPR of Film Rights; Production & Distribution of Films & TV Serials; and Digital Media Content. It is also involved in trading in intellectual property rights of films, as well as post production activities. The company was formerly known as Galaxy Multimedia Limited. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
